text.text: Engine: Enhanced id Tech 3 Source Port | Original Hardware: IBM PC Compatible | Media: Original Return to Castle Wolfenstein Game Data | Graphics: OpenGL Hardware Rendering | Sound: Digital Audio | Resolution: 640×480p Original with Modern High-Resolution and Widescreen Support

text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: RealRTCW is an enhanced source port of Return to Castle Wolfenstein that modernizes the original game while remaining compatible with its official data files. It preserves the original single-player campaign while introducing improved visuals, updated enemy behavior, gameplay refinements, bug fixes, modern display support, and quality-of-life features. Designed to stay faithful to the original experience, RealRTCW provides a convenient way to enjoy one of the most influential first-person shooters of the early 2000s on modern hardware.
